optPageTitle.description: Browser tab title for the options page.

optTagline.message: Keyboard-driven playback control for every HTML5 video. Changes save automatically and sync across every machine signed into your Chrome.
optTagline.description: Subtitle under the app name in the options header.

optLoading.description: Placeholder shown while stored settings are being read.

optLoadError.message: Couldn't load settings. Reopen this page to try again.
optLoadError.description: Shown when reading stored settings fails so the page doesn't hang on the loading placeholder.

optFooter.description: Footer line of the options page.

optShortcutsTitle.description: Title of the key-binding editor section.

optShortcutsDesc.message: Bindings are matched top to bottom — on duplicate keys the first enabled match wins. Drag a row to change its priority.
optShortcutsDesc.description: Explanation under the Shortcuts section title.

optSpeedTitle.description: Title of the playback-rate limits section.

optSpeedDesc.message: Bounds and rounding applied after every speed change.
optSpeedDesc.description: Explanation under the Speed limits section title.

optHudTitle.description: Title of the on-video HUD settings section.

optHudDesc.message: The on-video overlay that shows the current speed plus mute and loop state.
optHudDesc.description: Explanation under the HUD section title.

optBackupDesc.message: Export to a file, import a saved file, or reset everything.
optBackupDesc.description: Explanation under the Backup section title.

optEmptyShortcuts.message: No shortcuts yet — add one to get started.
optEmptyShortcuts.description: Shown when the bindings list is empty.

optAddShortcut.description: Button that appends a new, unbound shortcut row.

actionSkipForward.description: Action label: jump ahead by N seconds.

actionSkipBackward.description: Action label: jump back by N seconds.

actionSpeedDelta.description: Action label: change playback rate by a relative amount.

actionSpeedSet.description: Action label: set playback rate to an absolute value.

actionSeekToStart.description: Action label: jump to the beginning of the video.

actionSeekToEnd.description: Action label: jump to the end of the video.

unitSeconds.description: Unit suffix for a seconds parameter input.

unitDelta.description: Unit suffix for a relative speed-delta parameter input.

unitRate.description: Unit suffix for an absolute playback-rate parameter input.

optDragReorder.description: Tooltip / aria-label for the drag handle on a shortcut row.

optEnabled.description: Tooltip for the enabled state of a shortcut toggle.

optDisabled.description: Tooltip for the disabled state of a shortcut toggle.

optDuplicate.description: Tooltip / aria-label for the duplicate-row button.

optDelete.description: Tooltip / aria-label for the delete-row button.

optPressKey.description: Shown in the key field while it is listening for a keystroke.

optUnbound.description: Shown in the key field when no key is assigned.

optClear.description: Button that unbinds a shortcut's key while keeping the row.

optSpeedMin.description: Label for the minimum playback-rate input.

optSpeedMax.description: Label for the maximum playback-rate input.

optSpeedRounding.description: Label for the playback-rate rounding selector.

optHudShow.description: Label for the HUD enable toggle.

optHudDuration.description: Label for the transient-overlay duration input.

optExport.description: Button that downloads the current settings as a file.

optImport.description: Button that opens a file picker to import settings.

optReset.description: Button that overwrites all settings with the shipped defaults.

optErrInvalidJson.description: Error shown when an imported file cannot be parsed as JSON.

optErrInvalidSettings.description: Error shown when an imported file fails schema validation.

optResetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to defaults? This overwrites your current shortcuts, speed limits, and HUD configuration.
optResetConfirm.description: Confirmation prompt before resetting all settings.

hudPlay.description: HUD overlay flashed when playback starts.

hudPause.description: HUD overlay flashed when playback pauses.

hudSkipForward.description: HUD overlay flashed when skipping forward.

hudSkipBackward.description: HUD overlay flashed when skipping backward.

hudMuted.description: HUD overlay flashed when audio is muted.

hudUnmuted.description: HUD overlay flashed when audio is unmuted.

hudPipOn.description: HUD overlay flashed when picture-in-picture turns on.

hudPipOff.description: HUD overlay flashed when picture-in-picture turns off.

hudSeekStart.description: HUD overlay flashed when seeking to the start.

hudSeekEnd.description: HUD overlay flashed when seeking to the end.

hudLoopOn.description: HUD overlay flashed when looping turns on.

hudLoopOff.description: HUD overlay flashed when looping turns off.
